headline: Initial capability creation focusing on literal values, full range coverage, and error handling

clusters.name: Formula instead of Value
clusters.detail: Agent writes Excel formulas instead of calculating values in Python and writing literals. Scorer does not recalculate formulas.

clusters.name: Incomplete/Empty Range
clusters.detail: Agent fails to fill all required cells in the answer range, leaving some empty.

clusters.name: Value Mismatch
clusters.detail: Agent calculates slightly wrong values (too high, too low, or different type).

clusters.name: Excel Error Text
clusters.detail: Agent writes cells containing Excel error strings (e.g., #VALUE!).
